blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu—Authorities in the Toledo City Police Station released a 31-year-old woman after her husband decided to forgive her for being unfaithful. About 48 hours after he allegedly caught her cheating on him, the husband, 41, submitted an affidavit stating he would not pursue a case. Last Sunday evening, Nov. 22, 2026, the wife and her 24-year-old boyfriend were arrested. They were found living together in a rented room in Barangay Población, Toledo City.
